'''Doran'enoks''' were [[Diet/Legends|carnivorous]], winged creatures that hunted in packs. They were captured by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] to become [[Shock trooper/Legends|Shock Troopers]]. Doran'enoks were hunted for [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]], and almost went [[Extinction|extinct]] during the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]], and seemingly vanished from [[Arda I]].<ref name="OAA1" />

==History==
During a cave-in, Doran'Enoks flooded into the base and began attacking [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebels]] on sight.

==Appearances==
*''[[Onslaught at Arda I]]'' {{1st}}
